[SWS_DM_01107] DTC Status Byte calculation
⌈
If DiagnosticCommon-
Props.typeOfEventCombinationSupported is configured, the DM shall calculate
the UDS DTC status byte according to Table 7.5 for all events with event com-
bination that are mapped to DTCs in that DiagnosticCommonProps.
